meta.note: Colors and type exported from Figma (Design Tokens plugin). Spacing, radius, border width, shadows, focus ring, page background, success and blue-soft were derived from component screenshots or added for the Microcopy lab.

tokens.name: grey-main
tokens.usage: Primary text, labels and input values. 16:1 on white-main, 14.8:1 on bg-page.

tokens.name: grey-secondary
tokens.usage: Helper text, counters, placeholders, metadata. Darkened from Figma's #797979 (4.35:1, failed AA) to pass 4.5:1 on white-main and bg-page.

tokens.name: grey-tertiary
tokens.usage: Input, card and chip borders; dividers. 1.5:1 on white: below the 3:1 WCAG asks of control borders, so never let a border be the only cue that a field exists.

tokens.name: grey-bgdisabled
tokens.usage: Disabled field fill; skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: grey-textdisabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: blue-main
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, focus border, selected chip, links. White on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: blue-clicked
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: blue-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled and loading primary button fill.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Added. Selected chip fill and secondary button hover; blue-main text on it 6.3:1.

tokens.name: red-main
tokens.usage: Error borders, error icon and message text. 6.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: green-main
tokens.usage: Added. Success: the "Copied" check. 5.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: white-main
tokens.usage: Field, card and chip surface; text on blue-main and grey-main.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Added from the Figma canvas. App background behind cards.

groups.name: Copymopy
groups.note: Inter from Google Fonts, 400 and 600. Regular and bold pairs per size.

styles.name: body-16-bold
styles.usage: Large button labels, emphasis. Line height is 20px here but 22px on body-16, as exported from Figma; check whether that is intended.

styles.name: body-16
styles.usage: Generated copy in result cards, input values.

spacing.note: 4px base, read from the component screenshots.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to field, icon to text in messages.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Field to helper text; gap between chips; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field inner padding; small button side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; button side padding; gap between result cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Square-ish controls, rounder cards, pill chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, text areas.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Result cards, toast, empty state.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Tone chips.

borderWidth.note: Fields and chips thicken on focus or selection.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Fields, cards, chips at rest.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused or errored field; selected chip.

shadow.note: Flat by default: borders separate, shadows only float.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The toast, and anything else that floats over content.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, chips and icon buttons: a 2px white gap, then 2px blue-main, as in the Figma focused button.
